name: pinch
description: Perform a native simultaneous two-finger pinch around x/y. Scale is final finger separation divided by initial separation: >1 spreads fingers (zoom in), <1 brings them together (zoom out). The app decides its actual zoom and limits. No single-finger approximation. Requires native idb pinch support. Pass screenshotId to use returned-image pixel coordinates with automatic conversion. Without screenshotId, coordinates and distances use simulator points.

radius.description: Initial distance of each finger from the center, in the same units as x/y (default 100). Choose a center/radius so the gesture fits the screen.

screenshotId.description: Optional ID from screenshot. Coordinates (plus scroll distance, default 200, and pinch radius, default 100) then use pixels of that returned image; MCP converts automatically. Without it, use simulator points. Recapture after rotation, navigation or device switching.

name: screenshot
description: Return images in content and metadata in structuredContent. Single mode: {screenshotId, mode, imageSize, deviceInfo: {deviceId, screenSize, scale}}. Both: {images: [logical metadata, pixel metadata]} in the same order as image blocks. screenSize is in points; imageSize in pixels; deviceInfo.scale is native screen pixels per point, identical in logical and pixel modes. Pass screenshotId with image-pixel coordinates to gestures for automatic conversion; no manual math. An ID is returned only when mapping is available. IDs last 5 minutes, newest 20 per device per server session. Recapture after rotation or navigation; references are bound to their device. Optional mode, format, quality and maxBytes override saved settings for this call only (also in operation_chain); no persistent settings change. Default mode logical: image pixels equal touch points; pixel returns native dimensions; both returns logical then pixel from one capture. screenSize and scale are null if unavailable. Default PNG, maxBytes 5000000 per image.

mode.description: logical: one image pixel per touch point (default); pixel: native pixels; both: logical then pixel from one capture.

format.description: PNG (default) preserves UI text without lossy compression. JPEG can save bandwidth.

quality.description: JPEG quality only; ignored for PNG.

maxBytes.description: Default 5000000 (5 MB) per image. Maximum encoded image bytes BEFORE Base64 (~4/3 expansion). Returns an error if the requested dimensions cannot fit; never silently resizes.

path.description: Optional original PNG output path. Explicit paths are not auto-deleted; omitted paths use managed history with maxSavedImages retention.
